title: Stack .NET Developer / Algorithm Engineer – Backend Focus. at CloudGeometry
description_review: Full Stack .NET Developer / Algorithm Engineer with backend focus at CloudGeometry, developing healthcare cost reduction systems. Requires 6+ years experience in C#/.NET Core 8+, Entity Framework, microservices, REST APIs, and strong data structures/algorithms. Remote position based in Brazil.
pros: Requires 6+ years experience, microservices architecture, and RESTful APIs
Matches candidate's C# experience and strong OOP design patterns background
Focuses on complex data-driven architecture and clean, high-quality code
cons: Primary tech stack is .NET/C# rather than core Java/Spring Boot
Weak fit per profile guidelines for non-AI .NET-only roles

title: Senior back-end Engineer at Lemon.io
location: EU, US, Canada, UK, Australia, Singapore, Ireland, Norway, Switzerland, Iceland, and Mexico
description_review: Senior Back-end Engineer role via Lemon.io for a research-driven open-source AI infrastructure company. Involves building next-generation AI platforms, requiring 5+ years backend development and 2+ years AI agent development alongside Python, Golang, and Kubernetes. Remote across EU, US, Canada, UK, and Mexico.
pros: Explicit requirement for 2+ years AI agent development directly aligns with candidate's multi-agent platform and harness development
Senior backend role with extensive remote eligibility (EU, US, Mexico, etc.)
High alignment with candidate's applied GenAI and software architecture priorities
cons: Specific opening mentions Golang/Python as primary languages rather than Java/Spring Boot
Staffing/matchmaking network model via Lemon.io rather than direct hire

title: Head of Engineering at Lemon.io
description_review: Head of Engineering position at Lemon.io to lead platform transformation from services-driven marketplace to technology-driven platform. Requires 10 years experience to own technical roadmap, lead and grow the engineering team, and make core architecture decisions alongside the founder. Remote in Europe, Latin America, or USA.
pros: Hands-on engineering leadership and architecture ownership for platform transformation
Remote eligibility across Europe and Latin America
cons: Executive Head of Engineering role requiring 10+ years experience, beyond candidate's 7+ years Senior SWE focus
Salary field falsely captured marketplace annual GMV ($16M) instead of actual compensation
Does not focus on hands-on Java/Spring Boot microservices development
